question: What twelve forms are declared above the eight forms?
premises: Above the eight forms are twelve.
They range from Vama to Eka Shiva.
inference: Twelve radiant saffron forms, from Vama to Eka Shiva, are declared above the eight forms.
plain_english: Above the eight forms, twelve radiant saffron forms are declared, ranging from Vama to Eka Shiva.
